definitions.gloss: bathroom; bathing area (the wet room with the tub)
definitions.explanation: The room in a Japanese house where one washes and bathes — containing the bathtub and a tiled washing area. Distinct from the toilet, which is a separate room.

examples.japanese: {風呂場|ふろば}を{掃除|そうじ}した。
{風呂場|ふろば}の{床|ゆか}が{滑|すべ}りやすいので{気|き}をつけて。
examples.english: The bathroom floor is slippery, so be careful.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}いアパートだったので、{風呂場|ふろば}とトイレが{同|おな}じ{部屋|へや}にあった。
examples.english: It was an old apartment, so the bath and the toilet were in the same room.

notes:
{風呂|ふろ} (bath) + {場|ば} (place). Refers specifically to the wet area where one bathes — in a typical Japanese home this is a separate room from the toilet ({トイレ}) and from the dressing area ({脱衣所|だついじょ}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風呂場|ふろば}を{掃除|そうじ}する: to clean the bathroom
- {風呂場|ふろば}の{排水口|はいすいこう}: bathroom drain
- {風呂場|ふろば}で{転|ころ}ぶ: to slip in the bathroom

SIMILAR WORDS:
- お{風呂|ふろ}: the bath (the act or the tub itself)
- {浴室|よくしつ}: bathroom — more formal, used in real estate and instructions
- {脱衣所|だついじょ}: changing area just outside the bath
- トイレ: toilet — a separate room in most Japanese homes
